open_questions: StateStore.lockDue / EventStore.lockUndispatched are outside my files and have no exclude list; AdvanceLoop and EventDispatcher fetch (failed+1) rows and skip failed ones instead (locks failed rows for that small tx). OK, or should the interfaces get an exclude parameter?
CDP_LOOP_MAX_DRAIN is bound by a new com.cdp.delivery.LoopProperties (cdp.loop.max-drain) because EngineProperties is not in my files; move it if preferred.

Design says drop rabbit.invoke, but sending each message on its own channel hangs when the broker is paused (channel with pending confirms is not returned to the cache, a new channel RPC blocks ~130s, breaking DeliveryResilience). The relay therefore sends and awaits confirms inside one rabbit.invoke, still outside any DB transaction.
